explanation: It was part of the Summer Games from 1900 to 1920. Britain won gold in 1908 and 1920 with teams drawn from the City of London Police.
learnMore: Tug of war at the Summer Olympics

claims.text: Tug of war was an Olympic event at the Summer Games from 1900 to 1920.
Great Britain won the Olympic tug of war in 1908 and 1920 with teams from the City of London Police.

evidence.restatement: Tug of war was contested at the Olympics in 1900, 1904, 1908, 1912 and 1920 (plus the unrecognised 1906 Games) and then dropped.
City of London Police won the 1908 gold, and Britain's winning side in 1920 was again drawn from the City of London Police. Sweden won in 1912, which the claim does not mention.
